chapters.goal: Wire SceneModel into the live pipeline and suppress promoted static furniture without waking VLM or alerting.

atoms.title: Add live scene-memory config
atoms.task: Add explicit config fields for scene memory root, wall-clock warmup seconds, furniture IoU threshold, near-zero plate-diff threshold, and save interval.
acceptance: Default warmup is inside the accepted 120-300 second band.
Warmup outside 120-300 seconds is rejected or normalized by config validation.
Save interval must be positive and is available to LivePipeline.from_config.

atoms.title: Replace frame-count readiness for suppression with wall-clock warmup
atoms.task: Add per-camera wall-clock readiness to SceneModel without removing existing frame_count persistence compatibility.
acceptance: Suppression readiness is false before warmup_seconds have elapsed for that camera.
Suppression readiness is true after warmup_seconds have elapsed for that camera.
Existing serialized scene data without wall-clock fields still loads.

atoms.title: Extract pure scene update functions
atoms.task: Create pure helpers that update plate, spatial grid, and furniture observations from one frame plus detections, without disk I/O.
acceptance: Each processed frame increments SceneModel frame_count in memory.
SpatialGrid receives detection class/conf observations for matched cells.
BackgroundPlate receives per-cell observations and respects the moving flag.
Helper has no SceneStore.save call and performs no filesystem writes.
atoms.serial_reason: Depends on final SceneModel warmup contract.

atoms.title: Compute plate-diff motion score for detection cells
atoms.task: Add a deterministic helper that maps a detection bbox to grid cells and returns its plate-diff motion score.
acceptance: Empty or out-of-frame bboxes return a conservative moving score.
Known unchanged cells produce a near-zero score.
Changed cells above threshold are not classified as static.
atoms.serial_reason: Same source/test file as the scene update helper.

atoms.title: Add promoted furniture match predicate
atoms.task: Implement a class plus IoU predicate that matches detections against promoted FurnitureRegistry entries.
acceptance: A detection with matching class and IoU above threshold matches promoted furniture.
A detection with wrong class never matches, even with high IoU.
A non-promoted furniture entry never suppresses.
atoms.serial_reason: Same predicate module as prior atoms.

atoms.title: Add conjunctive suppression decision
atoms.task: Implement one explicit suppression predicate requiring warmup-ready scene, promoted furniture match, and near-zero plate-diff motion.
acceptance: During warmup the predicate never suppresses.
Promoted furniture plus near-zero motion suppresses.
Promoted furniture plus moving plate-diff does not suppress.
Non-promoted detections do not suppress.
atoms.serial_reason: Same predicate module as prior atoms.

atoms.title: Wire SceneStore into LivePipeline hot path
atoms.task: Use SceneStore.get_or_create per camera, update SceneModel in memory every frame, and call SceneStore.save only on throttle/change cadence plus shutdown flush.
acceptance: Every LivePipeline.run frame updates the camera SceneModel in memory.
SceneStore.save is not called once per frame when frames arrive faster than the configured save interval.
Forced flush persists pending scene state when the pipeline is flushed or stopped.

atoms.title: Suppress VLM wake and alert in LivePipeline
atoms.task: Call the suppression decision at the single VLM-gate decision point and emit a suppressed PipelineEventResult with no VLM query and no alert.
acceptance: Suppressed promoted-static-furniture events do not call the VLM provider.
Suppressed promoted-static-furniture events do not send bridge alerts.
PipelineEventResult exposes a suppression reason distinct from existing static_object deferral.
atoms.serial_reason: Must be integrated after pure predicate and SceneStore wiring.

atoms.title: Make furniture promotion source explicit
atoms.task: Review the existing EventBuilder static track signal and expose only the intended durable observation data needed by FurnitureRegistry, with tests documenting class filtering.
acceptance: Tests document which classes can enter the static-track signal.
FurnitureRegistry population does not silently treat an unknown class source as suppressible promoted furniture.
Existing static person/animal VLM deferral behavior remains covered.
atoms.serial_reason: Architect must review because Decision Record DA-005 and red-team notes conflict on the meaning of _static_track_ids.

atoms.task: Run the complete OKO pytest suite after Chapter 2 wiring and capture results for architect review.
acceptance: Full pytest in C:\Users\rafie\bridge-projects\oko exits 0.

chapters.goal: Collect structured labels from real person/animal events without parsing VLM free text as class truth.

atoms.title: Add labeled crop store
atoms.task: Create a crop writer that stores image crops and metadata JSON under runs/labels/<camera_id>/.
acceptance: Crop metadata includes camera_id, timestamp, bbox, class_name, conf, cell, model_version, and raw vlm_description.
vlm_description is stored only as raw context and is not parsed into class_name.
Writes are atomic enough to avoid orphan metadata on crop write failure.

atoms.title: Hook label crop collection into real events
atoms.task: Call the crop writer only for confirmed real person/animal events after VLM/operator agreement.
acceptance: Confirmed person/animal events create one crop record per agreed detection.
Suppressed furniture/normal events do not create positive labels.
VLM free text never overrides YOLO class_name in stored structured labels.
atoms.serial_reason: Depends on the crop store contract.

chapters.goal: Freeze an immutable held-out split and report precision, recall, and confusion.

atoms.title: Create immutable held-out split manifest
atoms.task: Build a manifest generator that freezes held-out samples with camera/time/class stratification metadata.
acceptance: A held-out manifest is immutable after creation unless a new version is requested.
Manifest records source crop IDs, camera_id, timestamp, class_name, and split version.
Attempting to mutate an existing held-out version fails loudly.

atoms.title: Compute held-out metrics
atoms.task: Compute precision, recall, and confusion matrix for a detector output against the frozen held-out manifest.
acceptance: Metrics include per-class precision and recall.
Confusion matrix includes missed and false-positive buckets.
Empty held-out sets fail with a clear error instead of passing.
atoms.serial_reason: Same eval module as split manifest.

chapters.goal: Export a versioned YOLO-format dataset with hard negatives.

atoms.title: Export versioned YOLO dataset
atoms.task: Export images, labels, data.yaml, and manifest.json under runs/datasets/<version>/.
acceptance: Agreed detections are exported as YOLO labels with normalized bbox coordinates.
Furniture and confirmed-normal examples are exported as hard negatives with empty label files.
data.yaml class mapping is deterministic and recorded in manifest.json.

chapters.goal: Train out-of-band, promote only on held-out improvement, and support rollback plus one Telegram confirmation.

atoms.title: Add out-of-band fine-tune job CLI
atoms.task: Create a GPU preflight and training job entry point accepting dataset_version, base_weights, and train_config.
acceptance: Training refuses to start without an existing dataset version and base weights.
GPU availability check is explicit and testable by dependency injection.
Training outputs a manifest with input versions and produced weights path.

atoms.title: Add held-out promotion gate
atoms.task: Stage candidate weights, evaluate them against current weights, and switch active weights only on margin plus per-class recall criteria.
acceptance: Candidate weights are not promoted unless aggregate metrics exceed the configured margin.
Candidate weights are rejected if any safety-critical class recall regresses beyond epsilon.
Active weights switch is atomic and records old and new versions.
atoms.serial_reason: Promotion must be implemented after training output manifest.

atoms.title: Add explicit and automatic rollback
atoms.task: Implement rollback to retained prior weights and automatic rollback on post-promotion validation failure.
acceptance: Rollback restores the previous active weights pointer.
Retention keeps the configured number of prior weight sets.
A failed post-promotion validation triggers rollback and records the reason.
atoms.serial_reason: Same promotion module as the gate.

atoms.title: Send one Telegram promotion confirmation
atoms.task: Send exactly one Telegram confirmation after a successful promotion and record it in the promotion manifest.
acceptance: A successful promotion emits one confirmation message.
Rejected candidates and rollbacks do not emit a success confirmation.
Notification failures are recorded and do not corrupt the active weights pointer.

atoms.task: Run the complete OKO pytest suite and capture final architect-review evidence.
acceptance: Full pytest in C:\Users\rafie\bridge-projects\oko exits 0.
Final report includes held-out eval, dataset export, promotion gate, rollback, and notification tests.
